recent_posts.title: The Story of Kodeco (raywenderlich.com)—A Journey of Passion, Learning, and Community
recent_posts.summary: Ray Wenderlich reflects on the 15-year journey of Kodeco (raywenderlich.com), detailing its humble beginnings as a blog, the growth of its tutorial community, key turning points including the shift to Swift and a subscription model, and the creation of RWDevCon, a popular in-person developer conference.

recent_posts.title: Debugging Projects in Godot
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to effectively debug projects in Godot using its powerful suite of debug tools. Understand the functionality and importance of the Debugger Panel and breakpoints to identify and fix issues in your game code. This comprehensive guide provides step-by-step instructions for utilizing Godot's debugging features to enhance your game development process.

recent_posts.title: Developing for the Meta Quest 3 with Unreal Engine 5
recent_posts.summary: Develop VR experiences for Meta Quest 3 using Unreal Engine 5 and the OpenXR API plugin. This guide covers the setup of VR templates, creation of customized interactions like teleportation and grab actions, and step-by-step instructions for deploying to your device. Learn to use Blueprints to manage VR player controllers and navigate through the VR dungeon environment.

recent_posts.title: Making Responsive UI in Godot
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to create responsive UIs in Godot Engine using settings and nodes like CanvasLayer, Anchor, NinePatchRect, and GridContainer. This tutorial covers the key principles of responsive UI design, including reference resolution, aspect ratio, and toggling between fullscreen and windowed modes. Basic knowledge of Godot Engine and GDScript is recommended.

recent_posts.title: How to Import Assets in Godot
recent_posts.summary: This guide helps technically-minded creators import free assets into Godot, using sites like Sketchfab and TurboSquid. It covers the essentials of Godot's import process and setting up a main menu scene for a horror game. The tutorial explains which file types are supported and provides steps to import and set up 3D models, textures, and audio files. By the end, users will have created a prototype main menu with imported assets.

recent_posts.title: Exporting Your Godot Project to Windows and Linux
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to export your Godot projects to Windows and Linux with this comprehensive tutorial. Topics covered include export templates, preset configurations, platform-specific settings, and creating distribution-ready builds. Understand how to navigate the export window, manage export templates, and configure various export settings to effectively reach your audience on platforms like Steam and itch.io.

recent_posts.title: Publishing Your Godot Project to itch.io
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to export a Godot project to a web format and publish it on itch.io. This tutorial covers creating the web export using HTML, WebAssembly, and WebGL 2.0. It provides steps on setting up the export, creating it, and finalizing it, including handling export templates and packaging the files. Finally, it walks through the process of publishing the exported game on itch.io, detailing how to create a new project and optimize the visibility of your game.

recent_posts.title: Getting Started with 2D Physics in Godot
recent_posts.summary: Learn about the basics of Godot 2D physics engine and how to use it to build a Marble drop game. Topics covered include different kinds of physics nodes, PhysicsMaterial, and creating a RigidBody2D node.
